title: Using AI imaging to recreate dreamscapes
content: As a member of this group for quite some time, I know some people are fans of AI imaging to recreate dreamscapes and some aren’t crazy for it. Personally, I find it astounding. Whenever I see fellow “mall worlders” posting their creations, I’m usually left in awe. I dabbled on an AI page recently and I feel like I was shy at first.. typing in basic prompts: “carousel at beach” or “trippy mall”. But then I realized how specific you can be… and I found myself typing detailed prompts: “abandoned neighborhood with cookie cutter mansions with a desert in the background, dusk time” I played around with these phrases until they were PERFECT. some dreamscapes I have not been able to visually perfect…. Yet. I promised myself I wouldn’t post any AI pics on here unless they REALLY spoke to me. sooo here ya go! Pics 1 & 2 depict the abandoned neighborhood filled with mansions. Some mansions are still occupied and the owners are welcoming. There’s a desert nearby. Pics 3 & 4 depict the basement level of the school. Ball pits, locker rooms and school pools. Pic 5: Birds Eye view of my beach world Pic 6: I wrote a very detailed passage about this location in the past. It’s a motel in the city that I’ve stayed at.
